name: Rahat Sayyed
summary: Full stack Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience building React.js and Next.js frontends backed by Node.js and REST APIs, plus AI-integrated systems and blockchain. Architected a system-wide state management refactor that cut initial load time by 11 seconds, and optimized Docker builds on AWS EC2, decreasing development build time by ~10 minutes per cycle.

experience.title: Software Engineer

Built a unified violations ingestion pipeline across LLM, MCP and RAG flows, reducing incident investigation time by approximately 40% through centralized event tracing.
Created D3-based interactive risk analytics dashboards that accelerated policy debugging and strengthened audit traceability across 12+ policies.
Coordinated frontend, backend, and AI teams to integrate 3+ evolving model capabilities with governance constraints while the platform introduced new tools and agents.
